correlation_analysis.analysis_summary: No log events were provided for analysis, therefore no direct mappings to the retrieved MITRE techniques could be established. Retrieval of techniques succeeded, but without event data the confidence assessment is not applicable.
overall_recommendations: Implement continuous monitoring for indicators of the retrieved techniques, such as:
• Unexpected creation of scheduled tasks (Windows) or cron jobs (Linux/macOS) – monitor Task Scheduler and cron logs.
• Download or execution of container/VM images from untrusted sources – enforce image provenance verification and signed image policies.
• Exploitation attempts against client applications – deploy up‑to‑date patches, enable exploit protection, and monitor for anomalous process launches from browsers, Office, or PDF readers.
• Connections to unknown or unsecured Wi‑Fi networks – enforce network access controls and monitor wireless association logs.
• Any execution of code from suspicious image files – use application whitelisting and integrity verification for VM/container images.
